metadata.diagnostic_events: external=True, enable_timing=True; N+1 boundary event nodes
metadata.aggregation: Per rank sample median, then maximum rank; layer means only over listed layers.
metadata.timing_warning: Only uninstrumented variants use the unchanged full-planner latency protocol. Stage/profiler records perturb execution and cannot replace it.

stages.name: pre_sync
stages.note: Native peer-mapped NVLink rank synchronization included in the baseline timer.

stages.name: native_seed
stages.note: Native planner includes internal NVLink synchronization; this is not pure local compute.

stages.name: sample_sum
stages.note: Live sampled-route/owner packet SUM across all eight physical ranks.

stages.name: residency_select
stages.note: Multiple CUDA kernels; use eager mapping trace for internal kernel attribution.

stages.name: materialize_prepare
stages.note: Includes stable order preparation / CUB sorting and local expert counts.

stages.name: fallback_select
stages.note: GPU eq plus cu/FIELDS where selection; runs even when no fallback is needed.

stages.name: publication_write
stages.note: Writes provenance to peer-mapped NVLink metadata; not purely local compute.

instrumented.scope: Instrumented CUDA Graph, one replay/sample, explicit external event at every boundary.
instrumented.warning: Diagnostic event nodes perturb execution. Max-rank stage medians need not share a rank/sample; do not sum them as a measured critical path.

instrumentation_comparison.warning: Different replay batching (configured vs one) plus event-node perturbation; this delta is not a calibrated event-overhead subtraction.

traces.warning: Profiler traces are attribution diagnostics, not formal latency measurements.
